title: Returning user logs in and reaches dashboard
description: Verifies an existing user can log in from the login page and is redirected into the authenticated dashboard at /app.

steps.description: Navigate to /login
Fill in the email field with {{LOGIN_USER}}
Fill in the password field with {{LOGIN_PASSWORD}}
Submit the login form
Verify the user lands on the dashboard

title: Unauthenticated user is redirected to login when accessing dashboard and can continue after signing in
description: Verifies the auth guard redirects an unauthenticated visit to /app to /login and allows access to the dashboard after successful login.

steps.description: Navigate to /app
Fill in the email field with {{LOGIN_USER}}
Fill in the password field with {{LOGIN_PASSWORD}}
Submit the login form
Verify the user lands on the dashboard

title: New user registers and proceeds to sign in
description: Verifies a new user can complete registration, see a success confirmation, and navigate to the login screen to sign in.

steps.description: Navigate to /register
Fill a valid name into the name field
Fill a unique email into the email field
Fill a valid password into the password field
Submit the registration form
Click the option to sign in after successful registration
Verify the user lands on the login page

title: Prospect navigates from landing page to registration
description: Verifies a public visitor can browse the landing page content and reach the registration page from a registration call-to-action.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Scroll through the landing page sections
Click the call-to-action to create an account
Verify the user lands on the registration page

title: Prospect navigates from landing page to login
description: Verifies a public visitor can browse the landing page content and reach the login page from a sign-in call-to-action.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Scroll through the landing page sections
Click the call-to-action to sign in
Verify the user lands on the login page

title: User requests password reset instructions
description: Verifies a locked-out user can submit the forgot-password form and sees instructions indicating next steps were provided.

steps.description: Navigate to /forgot-password
Fill a registered email into the email field
Submit the password recovery request
Verify an instruction or confirmation is shown indicating reset steps were sent

title: Login shows error for incorrect credentials
description: Verifies a user entering an incorrect password is shown an authentication error and is not logged in.

steps.description: Navigate to /login
Fill in the email field with {{LOGIN_USER}}
Fill an invalid password into the password field
Submit the login form
Verify an authentication error is visible

title: Landing page key marketing content is discoverable by scrolling
description: Verifies the landing page can be scrolled and core product sections like features and pricing/highlights are present for evaluation.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Scroll down until feature highlights are in view
Scroll down until pricing or plan highlights are in view
Verify product feature and pricing highlights are displayed

title: Registration shows required-field validation when data is missing
description: Verifies the registration form prevents submission with missing required information and shows a validation error.

steps.description: Navigate to /register
Fill a valid name into the name field
Fill a unique email into the email field
Leave at least one required field empty
Submit the registration form
Verify a required-field validation error is visible

title: Reset password requires matching confirmation
description: Verifies the reset-password form enforces that the new password and confirmation match before allowing completion.

steps.description: Navigate to /reset-password
Fill a valid new password into the new password field
Fill a different valid password into the confirmation field
Submit the reset password form
Verify a password mismatch validation error is visible
